description: This file implements a fake client for testing Kubernetes client interactions, including reaction chains, watch reactions, proxy reactions, and action recording.

classes.name: Fake
classes.description: A mock implementation of client.Interface for testing, supporting reaction chains, watch, proxy reactions, and action tracking.

classes.name: Reactor
classes.description: Interface for handling actions with a React method.

classes.name: WatchReactor
classes.description: Interface for handling watch actions with a React method.

classes.name: ProxyReactor
classes.description: Interface for handling proxy actions with a React method.

methods.name: AddReactor
methods.description: Appends a reaction to the reaction chain for specific verbs and resources.

methods.name: PrependReactor
methods.description: Prepends a reaction to the beginning of the reaction chain.

methods.name: AddWatchReactor
methods.description: Adds a watch reaction to the chain.

methods.name: PrependWatchReactor
methods.description: Prepends a watch reaction to the chain.

methods.name: AddProxyReactor
methods.description: Adds a proxy reaction to the chain.

methods.name: PrependProxyReactor
methods.description: Prepends a proxy reaction to the chain.

methods.name: Invokes
methods.description: Records an action and invokes the corresponding reaction, returning the result or default.

methods.name: InvokesWatch
methods.description: Records an action and invokes the watch reaction, returning the watch interface.

methods.name: InvokesProxy
methods.description: Records an action and invokes the proxy reaction, returning the response wrapper.

methods.name: ClearActions
methods.description: Clears the history of recorded actions.

methods.name: Actions
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list of actions recorded.
